headline: IMO Urges Hormuz Rule Enforcement
subheadline: What it means for ships trading in the Gulf
insight: IMO Secretary-General asks flag, port and coastal states to act on unsafe ships in Hormuz: 133 incidents and at least 25 seafarers killed since 28 Feb.

meta.description: On 11 November 2026 IMO Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez called on flag, port and coastal states to step up enforcement of IMO safety rules in the Strait of Hormuz. He cited substandard ships, vessels hiding their IMO numbers, fraudulent registrations and false flags. IMO has confirmed 133 incidents involving merchant ships since 28 February, with at least 25 seafarers killed. He also urged owners to avoid trading that exposes crews to unacceptable risk.
meta.question: Should port states detain ships that hide their IMO numbers?
